sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The motif of fairy theft holds that the fairies take goods in secret. Such a theft leaves no clue the eye can read. FAIRYLAND carries many names. Most of these names mark its fair aspect and its distance from the world of people.

okr.objective: Fairy theft is a motif of secret taking, set in a distant FAIRYLAND.
key_results: Fairy theft is a folklore motif of secret taking.
The fairies take goods in a way that leaves no visible clue.
FAIRYLAND carries many names, most marking a far and fair realm.
